report.explanation: Order, gateway, and inventory are healthy (p95 ~70ms, low error rate, OK traces). Payment shows p95 1600ms with error_rate 0.004, the only anomalous signal, but no payment traces or dependency detail exist to bound a cause. Order deployment (3.3.3, 491min old) cannot establish latency causation. Insufficient evidence for a bounded candidate; hand off for payment-path telemetry.
missing_evidence: Payment p95 latency of 1600ms vs ~70ms elsewhere: need payment traces/span breakdown to locate the slow segment
Payment dependency/DB pool and timeout detail beyond aggregate metrics
Checkout end-to-end traces covering the payment call path
Confirmation whether payment latency is the checkout degradation driver
